SandboxSubject.title: SandboxSubject
SandboxSubject.description: The sandbox admission subject (the W008 SandboxSurfaceDescription shape mirrored): extension identity + version + manifest digest + flavor + trust class + capability bindings + grants + data-handling classification + optional marketplace listing reference.

SubjectId.title: SubjectId
SubjectId.description: Opaque observation-subject identity: "<kind>:<slug>" (extension, session, simrun, action, principal, tenant, workspace, security-policy families).

ObservabilitySha256Hex.title: ObservabilitySha256Hex
ObservabilitySha256Hex.description: SHA-256 digest over canonical JSON: the exact-revision content address of a security record.

SandboxBinding.title: SandboxBinding
SandboxBinding.description: One resolved capability binding of a sandbox subject (an opaque typed reference into the W007 registry).

CapabilityBindingToken.title: CapabilityBindingToken
CapabilityBindingToken.description: One opaque capability-binding reference of a sandbox subject (capability ids resolve in the W007 registry).

SandboxGrant.title: SandboxGrant
SandboxGrant.description: One sandbox grant (the W008 shape): the capability it grounds plus the host functions and resource scopes it requests.

HostFunctionToken.title: HostFunctionToken
HostFunctionToken.description: One host-function token of a sandbox grant (validated against the W008 vocabulary by the isolation check).

ResourceScopeToken.title: ResourceScopeToken
ResourceScopeToken.description: One (resource, access) scope token of a sandbox grant (validated against the W008 legal table by the isolation check).
